decisions.reason: The vegan superfood drink builds on the firm's biomass-to-nutrients knowledge, but consumer food marketing lies far from its engineering core, so its ability to interpret and act on market feedback is weak, which makes it the most vulnerable product, though not enough to drop yet.
The modular waste-to-energy extensions draw directly on the firm's established plant engineering and in-house prototyping, so it can readily assimilate early results and improve the models.
The waste-oil-to-energy plant is a flagship with its own page and rests on the firm's core energy-from-waste knowledge, with R&D and university cooperation supporting further development.

The plastic-to-fuel plant is a strategic flagship close to the firm's conversion expertise, and its own R&D and research partnerships give it the knowledge to refine this newer technology despite technical uncertainty.
